summary: Iteration 89 — RevenueCat identity fix (rcIsAnonymous() using Purchases.getAppUserID()/isAnonymous() instead of customerInfo.originalAppUserId) VERIFIED on web preview 390x844 (RevenueCat Test Store). All 3 requested scenarios PASS. (1) USER1 fresh signup at '/' (Get Started → onboarding Continue → Signup Test I89 / test_i89_1790729502@example.com / Password123! + T&C) → hard paywall renders with paywall-iap-buy visible. Pre-buy paywall-notice EMPTY (no 'anonymous customer' / 'Purchases can't start yet' text). Tap paywall-iap-buy → paywall-iap-confirm dialog appears with notice STILL empty (no anonymous error). Tap paywall-iap-confirm-yes → RC 'Test Store Purchase' dialog (Product: pro.annual, Price: $79.99) → click 'Test valid purchase' → paywall disappears, home-profile testID becomes visible, Home dashboard 'Good evening, Test.' rendered with Home/Budget/Reports/Activity/Wealth/Legacy bottom tabs. Result: {anon_pre:false, confirm:true, anon_after:false, unlocked:true}. (2) USER2 fresh signup (test_i89b_1790729502@example.com) → hard paywall → tap paywall-iap-restore → paywall-notice = 'No previous App Store purchases were found for this account.' — exactly the expected message. No 'anonymous customer' / 'Purchases can't start yet' notice. Result: {restore_present:true, expected:true, anon:false}. (3) Browser console (captured with page.on('console')) is CLEAN of RC identity errors — logged 'identity bound: user_41a031a8f22d' + 'identity bound: user_48b721969192' confirmations. No TypeError about getAppUserID / isAnonymous not being a function, no pageerror events, no 'anonymous' / 'identity_not_ready' error strings. The only warnings are the pre-existing 'Require cycle: revenuecat.tsx -> AuthContext.tsx -> revenuecat.tsx' (unchanged from prior iterations) and RC EventsTracker debug flush logs (200 OK). The identity fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx (new rcIsAnonymous() reading Purchases.getAppUserID() + Purchases.isAnonymous(), consumed by ensureRcReady, purchase choke point, and identityReady) resolves the TestFlight 'Purchases can't start yet: account link failed (anonymous customer)' regression on the web preview surrogate.

critical_code_review_comments: revenuecat.tsx:100-109 — rcIsAnonymous() correctly prefers Purchases.getAppUserID()+isAnonymous() and only falls back to startsWith('$RCAnonymousID:') on exception. The exception-branch fallback is safe because a real logged-in appUserId will not start with '$RCAnonymousID:'.

revenuecat.tsx:172-180 — purchase choke point now calls rcIsAnonymous() BEFORE Purchases.purchasePackage(), so an anonymous SDK state throws 'identity_not_ready' locally rather than surfacing the RC 'account link failed' error mid-purchase.
revenuecat.tsx:196 — identityReady derives from the app-user-id query (rcIsAnonymous) rather than customerInfo.originalAppUserId, matching the fix intent.

PaywallScreen.tsx:110-116 — buyWithStore() self-heals via ensureRcReady() when identityReady is false, and only surfaces 'Purchases can't start yet: <error>' when the ensureRcReady returns ok:false. In our tests it never returned false, so no 'anonymous customer' notice ever appeared.

rca_of_issue: Original TestFlight bug: after native Purchases.logIn(uid) aliases the anonymous customer to the Jaleter user id, customerInfo.originalAppUserId stays '$RCAnonymousID:...' forever (that's the ID the customer was FIRST created with). The previous code inspected originalAppUserId to decide anonymity, so it always returned true and the purchase choke point rejected every real buyer with 'account link failed (anonymous customer)'. Fix: rcIsAnonymous() now asks the SDK for the CURRENT app user id (Purchases.getAppUserID()) and calls Purchases.isAnonymous(), which correctly returns false after logIn(). Reproduction: web preview does not repro the original bug because purchases-js uses reconfigure-with-appUserID instead of logIn(), but the same rcIsAnonymous() code path is exercised and returns non-anonymous both before Subscribe Now and before Restore Purchase, proving neither surface can display the 'account link failed' notice.
